power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.name: Taɛrabt
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.descr: Alfiq yesεan iẓeṭṭiyen i d-yettwaṭṭfen s uẓeṭṭi; ttḥewwin-d lbaṭel i yiẓeṭṭiyen i d-yeffɣen, tezmer ad d-teṭṭef ɣer lqaεa (Tezmer ad tt-teddun)

power.medievalorigins.alfiq.on_your_feet: Ma yella, mi ara d-teɣliḍ, tettmuqulem ɣer lqaεa, ur d-teṭṭfeḍ ara ayen i d-yeǧǧan ad d-teɣli.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pickpocket.d: S ufella n ufella n umdan n taddart mi ara d-yeṭṭef s iḍaṛṛen-is yeččuṛen, ad d-tekkes kra n tmazirt, neɣ ad ttwaṭṭfen.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.name: Ad d-teffɣeḍ
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.descr: Mi yeṭṭef cwiṭ n wakud ur yeddu ara ad d-yekkes, Alfiq yezmer ad d-yekkes ɣer deffir.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.poor_grip.de: Alfiq εeṭṭlen taṣṣebḥit n uḍebsi s uḍebsiyen yerna εeṭṭlen tiɣawsiwin s uḍebsiwen am yijenwiyen d isekkilen.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.agile_prefer: Alfiq iḥemmel ad yeṭṭef isekkilen ifecḥen kan akken ad yeddu deg-s. Isekkilen imeqqranen zemren ad tt-yeṭṭfen ur d-tettwaḥseb ara s lxir.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.meow.name: Meow
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.bottomles: Arachnae teḥwaǧen aṭas n wučči akken ad qqimen d imdanen.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.brittle.d: D acu i d-yeǧǧan ara d-yeǧǧen ad d-tḥewwṣeḍ ma yella tesɛam taɛrabt i yeɛnan ugar n ṭṭabla.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.climber.d: Iɣil-nni imecṭuḥen i yellan deg iḍarren n Arachnae ttwaǧǧan-as ad d-yeddun ɣef lḥiḍ.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.fragile_e: Iɣil-nni n Arachnae yezga yettwaḥesben ugar i usemmiḍ.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.many_eyes: Tlata n wallen n Arachnae ttwaɣalen akk ɣer ṭṭlam, yerna ttwaǧǧan-asen ad walin akken iwata ɣas ma llan cwiṭ n tafat.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.venomous_: Tiɣriwin n Arachnae tesεan azrem, yerna yal taɣiwant tesεa tallelt ad d-tessefk azrem.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.spectral.d: Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg usefru n usefru n usefru n usefru n usefru n usefru n usefru n usefru n usefru n usefru n usefru n usefru.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.name: Yettwaṭṭef
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.desc: Kra n tikelt i ten-yeḍran, ulac tikti i d-yeǧǧan win i d-yeṭṭfen ad yeɣli ɣer lmut i d-yettunefken.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.immaterial: Ibansiyen yesɛan azgen n tezmert n wemdan yeddren.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.dimeritium: Timedyazin i d-yeffɣen s tmagit, am tẓaṛ neɣ azreb, ur ten-teṭṭef ara akk tibanziwin.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.lunar_nexu: Banshis ur d-yefki ara laẓ seg učči - tazmert-nsen tt-id-tefki kan s tafat n waggur, maca ur zmiren ara ad d-muten s laẓ.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.sonic_shri: Tiɣriwin n Banshee ttḥebṛen ɣef lmut. Tzemreḍ ad d-teffɣeḍ tiɣriwin, ad d-teffɣeḍ tiɣriwin i d-iqeṛṛben ɣer deffir, ad d-teqqel yiwet n temɣart tamecṭuḥt.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_sig: Tettunefkiḍ-d lmeḥna ugar mi tesεiḍ taεrabt.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_war: Tettaɣem-d ad d-terremḍem i yiɣallen i d-yettunefken ɣef yal taḥawsiṭ n tceṭṭiḍt i d-teṭṭfen.
Ma yella mačči d aksum n wemɣersiw, ulac azal-is.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.demon_fire: Incubi-nni d wid yesɛan tazmert n tmazight n tmes, yerna yezmer ad d-yefken tafat n tmes akken yebɣa.
Tafat tettḥulfu-d am uxxam - ur d-tettunefki ara i Incubi yerna tečča-t.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.hydrophobe: Aman ttḥewwin Incubi, ttwaḥesben-ten mi ara ten-id-temεicen.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.impure.des: Incubi ttwaṭṭfen tiɣriwin i yugaren seg Smite d tiɣriwin i d-yeqqimen seg uselmed d uguren.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.dimension_: Incubi-nni ur tt-ssneɛ ara tiɣriwin anda yeǧǧal yiṭij, ma d anda i ten-yeǧǧan tiɣriwin, ma d din i ten-yeǧǧan tazmert tameqqrant deg Tiɣri.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.unholy_dea: Aɛebbuḍ yezmer ad yerr kra n tesraft-is n tudert ɣef tesraft tamellalt i kra n lweqt.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.darkness_dwe: D tafat n yiṭij i d-yeffɣen allen n yizerfan, ad ten-id-yeqqimen s tallit.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.name: Tameqqrant
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.descri: Imezdaɣ-nni ẓẓayen aṭas ɣef leḥsab-nsen; ttɣessun s tɣawla deg waman.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dwarven_tech: Igerdan zemren ad rẓen taẓruft mebla taẓruft, yerna ad rẓen kra n tɣawsiwin ugar n wiyaḍ.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.miniature.de: Imezdaɣ-nni meqqren kan i wakken ad kecmen deg yiwet n tnect n teɣzi n 1 metru ( yerna qrib am yiwet).
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.nocturnal_ey: Izerfan zemren ad ẓren akken iwata, ur ḥwaǧen ara tafat.
Imezdaɣ yettwassnen s ccɣel-nsen iǧehden i d-yeǧǧan yiwen ad yeqqel ɣef snat n yiɣallen-nsen.
Imdanen ur d-beddlen ara seg wurar-nni n tazwara.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.archer.de: Iεelfan n teẓgi ttqeddcen tudert-nsen akk s uḍar - isefra-nsen zedɣen dima ugar.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.forest_vi: Mi llan deg yiɣil meqqren neɣ deg isefra, izerfan n teẓgi zmiren ad ṭṭfen iman-nsen akken ad d-afen taẓri deg yiḍ, yerna ur tt-id-ttwalin ara yimdanen i d-yezgan.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.eagle_eye: Imezdaɣ n lqaεa zmiren ad d-rren lεeεd kra n lweqt mi ara ten-yerẓen, ɣas ma ur ten-ttwali ara.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.empowered: Mi ara d-tessufeggeḍ aẓar kra n dduklan, serr-d asefru s tezɣit d tɣawsa i yugaren akken ad d-teffigeḍ ugar, yerna ad d-tessufeggeḍ deg sin iɛdawen.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.elegant.d: Imezdaɣ n lqaεa ur sεin azal n tezmert, yerna ttwaḥeṭṭlen s useṭṭi n tceṭṭaḍin imeqqranin (Yemmer ad tt-id-yeḥbes s tfeṛḥit).
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.steward.d: Imezdaɣ n teẓgi qqimen deg teẓgi, ur zmiren ara ad rẓent aksum.
Imezdaɣ n teẓgi meqqren cwiṭ ɣef wemdan amgarad.
Ur sɛin ara iẓuran d imeqqranen, maca ttɛeṣben.
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.name: Tameɣra
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.descrip: Fae d ayen i d-yettunefken s tuffra. Ad ten-d-yettunefken seg waṭas ugar n wayen i d-yettunefken wiyaḍ.
power.medievalorigins.fae.diminutive.des: Fae llan meqqren mliḥ, meqqren-d ɣas akken meqqren ugar n goblin amgarad.
Aẓaṛ d taɛrabt ttḥeṭṭlent tazmert n yizemren. D ayen ur ten-yefki ara ad tt-ssinen.
power.medievalorigins.fae.levitation.des: Fae d iɣersiwen ifeṭṭlen, yesɛan iḍawen i izemren ad rnun deg lehwa.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_blessi: Ssebba-d tazmert n tudert i yiẓuran n kra n wakud, ma yella tetteddu, tessebreḍ tizzirt-ik ɣef yiẓuran i d-yeṭṭfen, tessebreḍ tazmert n uselmed d uselkim i yimdukkal-ik i d-yezgan.
power.medievalorigins.fae.nourishment.de: Ssarem-d tazmert n tudert i d-yeffɣen deg-wen, s tɣawsa i d-yeffɣen iẓuran deg yiwet n temnaḍt i k-d-yeddun.
power.medievalorigins.fae.forest_kin.des: Akken i telliḍ deg tlelli n teẓgi, tiɣriwin-ik ttɛeṭṭlent.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_ward.d: Tettwaḥebbeḍ ɣer tidett, tettak-ak-d tazemma i usemmiḍ d usemmiḍ, yerna teṭṭfeḍ ɣef yimenɣiyen n tmedyazt.
power.medievalorigins.fae.reduced_health: Ifawen d izerfan iḥeṛcen i yesεan ur nesεi ara azal n tezmert n wemdan.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.cunning.des: Goblins d izerfan imecṭuḥen, yerna ẓran anda ara d-tafent ayen i d-yeǧǧan aṭas n wiyaḍ.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.name: Tameẓla
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.descr: Imi d imecṭuḥen-nsen, imecṭuḥen-nni ur sɛin ara tazmert, yerna tzemren ugar ad d-ḥsen.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.name: Yettzuɛen
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.desc: Imaziɣen-nni sεan yiwet n temsalt tamezwarut ɣer tẓuri - ttafen-asen-d iseflawen i yugaren mi ara xeddmen neɣ ara xeddmen ayen yellan d ddheb.
Aẓeṭṭa deg ufus n uqerruy tesɛedda aṭas ugar n wiyaḍ i tt-id-iḥebsen.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.name: Nimble
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.descr: Ɣas akken meẓẓiyit, tiɣriwin-nni ttεeṭṭlen mliḥ, dɣa tt-id-yeǧǧan ad rewlen ugar n iɛdawen yeǧhden, anda ur ttnaɣen ara.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.stunted.des: D imecṭuḥen mliḥ i d-yeqqimen goblins, deg lqaεa n war n uzgen n wemdan.
Gorgons ur zmiren ara ad ḥemmlen lfeṛḥ n waman, ur zmiren ara ad d-rren lbaṭel seg-s.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.to_stone.de: Gorgons llan ttwaḥasben ad qqimen ṭṭfen deg yiɣil n ṭṭlam d iẓuran iqdimen.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.silver_aver: Gorgons d imecṭuḥen i lfeṭṭa - ur zmiren ara ad tt-ssinen, ur zmiren ara ad tt-ssinen.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.petrifying_: Ssawḍ-d allen n kra n lɣaci i k-d-yettmuqulen, ttwalin-iten s uẓru s kra n lweqt. Ur ixeddem ara ɣef imeqqranen.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.poison_bloo: Gorgons d immuḍan i usemmiḍ, yerna sεan tikti ad ssersen idammen-nsen n usemmiḍ ɣef iɛdawen i d-yeqqimen, ad ten-ssemmen.
